bio: Your evening starts with snacks in the lounge of this welcoming suburban restaurant, before you take a seat at either a table or the counter to enjoy the procession of memorable dishes. The surprise menu features the finest European ingredients cooked with global influences, showcasing intense flavours and some original combinations. Finish the evening with tea or coffee and an impressive array of mignardises that are a real event. The engaging and attentive service is pitched just right.This restaurant is temporarily closed....
